ain-Latn.value: Commons or wa a=uk tatum (noka oruspe) anak poro kaspa wa a=uk eaykap.
ain-Latn.backtranslation: The data being received from Commons (information concerning the image) is too large, so it cannot be received.
ain-Latn.residual_limit: Configured response allowance is paraphrased as too large to receive; byte unit and exact maximum remain implicit.

ain-Kana.value: Commons オㇿ ワ アウㇰ タトゥㇺ (ノカ オルㇱペ) アナㇰ ポロ カㇱパ ワ アウㇰ エアイカㇷ゚.
ain-Kana.backtranslation: The data being received from Commons (information concerning the image) is too large, so it cannot be received.
ain-Kana.residual_limit: Same semantic compression as ain-Latn; Saru-oriented kana convention, not the glossary display convention.

mnc-Mong.value: ᠨᡳᡵᡠᡤᠠᠨ ᡳ Commons ᠴᡳ ᠠᠯᡳᠮᡝ ᡤᠠᡳᡥᠠ ᠮᡝᠵᡳᡤᡝ ᡳ ᡠᡥᡝᡵᡳ ᡴᡝᠮᡠᠨ ᡨᠣᡴᡨᠣᡥᠣ ᡴᡝᠮᡠᠨ ᠴᡳ ᡶᡠᠯᡠ.
mnc-Mong.backtranslation: The total amount of the image-information received from Commons is more than the fixed amount.
mnc-Mong.residual_limit: Ordinary information and measure vocabulary extended to digital descriptive data; byte unit and network-response terminology remain implicit.
mnc-Mong.romanization: nirugan i Commons ci alime gaiha mejige i uheri kemun toktoho kemun ci fulu.
